nodes.label: $wf-unity-ui-quick
nodes.detail: Receive a narrow Unity UI View or ViewModel change.

nodes.label: quick scope gate
nodes.detail: Confirm a maximum of two handwritten files and no protocol, cache, service, prefab, scene, generated-file, or cross-feature data-flow change.

nodes.label: quick-developer
nodes.detail: Read the relevant UI context and make the necessary safe handwritten change or targeted diagnostic.

nodes.label: quick-verifier
nodes.detail: Check behavior, compile risk, generated-file safety, and the available Unity Console or compile evidence.

nodes.label: deliver
nodes.detail: Return evidence, changed files, validation results, skipped checks, risks, or an escalation to the full UI workflow.
